title: Derived isomorphism for the fixed local relative tensor complex
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], E an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and G,K cochain complexes of O_X-modules. Fix eK:QK≅E tensor-derived QG [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let U be an open subset, L a strictly perfect complex of O_X|_U-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex], and eL:E|_U≅QL. Put R=f inverse-image O_S and let A be its underlying ring sheaf. In the standard localization of complexes of A|_U-modules at quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], the localization of (scalar restriction of K along R→O_X)|_U is isomorphic to the localization of strictPerfectRelativeTensorComplex f U L G [def-pc-strict-perfect-relative-tensor-complex]. This asserts only the local derived comparison, not the existence of a common complex or chain-map roof.

source.place: Tag 0DJQ, proof, local strict-perfect tensor calculation; Tag 06YH, derived tensor construction after K-flat resolutions; original roof node proof step 1 and the scalar-restriction part of step 2

proof.text: Transport L through the exact module equivalence Modules.overEquiv U to a complex P on U.toScheme. The equivalence sends each finite-free retract to a finite-free retract: use sigmaComparison and sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit to identify the ambient finite free modules. Such retracts are flat by ObjectProperty.flat_coproduct, prop_unit and flat_of_retract. Its boundedness is preserved by map_isZero. Apply bounded-above flat K-flatness on the open ringed space. The private retract helper is proved for arbitrary free rank and specialized here to ULift (Fin m).

Apply derivedTensor_openRestriction_iso_universes to E and QG and map eK through restriction. Use mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactors to transport eL and G to the open subscheme. Specialize kFlat_derivedTensor_comparison_natIso to the constant singleton families P and G restricted to the open subscheme. This gives an isomorphism from the restriction of QK to Q of their ordinary total tensor.

The natural tensor comparison for Modules.overEquiv U induces a bicomplex isomorphism via HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents, with naturality giving both differential equations. The equivalence preserves the coproducts in totalization, so mapTotalIso followed by total.mapIso yields the complex comparison. Map the preceding derived isomorphism through the inverse equivalence and compose with mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the complex-equivalence unit to return to the localized open site. The private total-tensor transport helper accepts any module equivalence with a natural tensor comparison; specialize it to Modules.overEquiv U and the existing tensor-equivalence theorem.

Restriction of scalars composed with toSheaf is definitionally toSheaf on the source. Since toSheaf preserves finite limits and colimits and reflects them, restriction of scalars is exact. Map the local isomorphism through its mapDerivedCategory and compose with mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Open restriction commutes definitionally with scalar restriction on complexes, and the target is definitionally strictPerfectRelativeTensorComplex. This produces the stated isomorphism in the standard base-ring localization.

theorem strictPerfect_relativeTensor_roof_comparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (G K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eK : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hL : IsStrictlyPerfect X U L)
    (eL : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) :
    let R := TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base S.sheaf
    let A := (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} (A.over U)) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} A U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
                (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (strictPerfectRelativeTensorComplex f U L G))
